topic: Data file structure and scheduling requirements
summary_markdown:
Someone (p1) provided feedback on data received from DateCorp. The primary modification requested is to consolidate all network data into a single file, rather than providing separate files for each network.

Regarding the weekly job, it was confirmed that scheduling should occur every Monday due to the weekly structure of the data.

[me] confirmed that grouping by network is possible and agreed to add a 'network' field. [me] committed to preparing and uploading the consolidated file today.
decisions: Data must be provided in a single file for all networks.
action_items: [me] will prepare and upload the consolidated data file today.
